name: @wildflowerhealthio/app-catalog-core-js
description: The schema of Wildflower's HALO 1.2 App Catalog, published at `https://app-catalog.wildflowerhealth.io/apps`: `Catalog` (the document), `App` (one application object) with its `Contact`, `Publisher` and `PreassignedCredentials`, the closed `Tag` list with its `TAG_LABELS`, and where the catalog is published (`CATALOG_PATH`, `CATALOG_JSON_PATH`, `CATALOG_URL`). No React, no DOM.
